name: NX Block Reason

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; connect-src https://dns.nextdns.io https://api.nextdns.io https://*.test.nextdns.io https://cloudflare-dns.com; img-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; style-src 'self'
